## RFQ Status (Rs)

Enum lifecycle for an RFQ (draft / sent / comparing / awarded / cancelled), built on the base `enumField`. The hue map (`RFQ_STATUS_COLORS`) is exported from the module that owns the enum, so every consumer colors states from one source and colors stay derived, never stored.

### Example

A primitive enum field cannot carry `containedExamples` — see the linked RFQ "Q1 Laptop Refresh", currently `comparing`.

### Non-goals

No per-status timestamps (the transitions that matter are commanded and auditable elsewhere); no custom statuses per consumer.
